purpose: Fail-closed operator checklist for promoting the optional ANPOS commercial service from certified staging to production sales.

required_gates.rule: Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-service repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.
Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-template repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.
Create GitHub App under intended publisher and store credentials only in approved secret storage.
Install GitHub App on the private commercial template with least privileges for enabled delivery modes.
Complete GitHub Marketplace verified-publisher and financial onboarding.
Configure actual prices/plan IDs and map them to developer/pro/team/enterprise without repository-side invented billing values.
Finalize Terms, Privacy, License/EULA, refund/cancellation, tax and support/SLA terms with appropriate legal/accounting review.
Configure production DATABASE_URL, GitHub App credentials, Marketplace mapping/webhook secret, Ed25519 signing key, operator token, vendor installation/repo identifiers and issuer URL.
Allow the Marketplace webhook endpoint through deployment protection while keeping operator/admin surfaces protected.
Verify /api/ready returns HTTP 200 against production configuration and migration checksum.
Verify real purchased/changed/cancelled events plus duplicate/retry/hash-conflict behavior against production.
Verify missed-event operator reconciliation against authenticated GitHub Marketplace state.
Verify entitled customer archive delivery from the vendor-private template.
Verify organization seat assign/revoke/capacity/principal-bound token refresh with a real organization.
Verify cancellation prevents future premium access without deleting, encrypting, remotely modifying or intentionally breaking generated customer repositories.
Verify production entitlement-ledger restore procedure and record current RPO/RTO evidence.
Deploy production from vendor-private source or a verified immutable artifact; do not rely on public canonical source access.

promotion_rule: Production sales are authorized only when every required gate has status=verified and evidence is recorded. Repository edits alone cannot set launch_authorized=true.
